question_text: Is the company validly existing and in good standing under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation, and duly qualified as a foreign corporation in all states where business operations require qualification?
remediation_action: File overdue annual franchise tax reports and obtain Certificates of Good Standing from the Secretary of State.

question_text: Does the capitalization table accurately reflect all authorized, issued, and outstanding shares, stock options, warrants, and SAFEs, and does the sum of individual equity holdings exactly tie to the total issued shares?
remediation_action: Reconcile the cap table ledger against all board consent resolutions and stock certificates with legal counsel.

question_text: Does the company own or control, directly or indirectly, any equity interest in any subsidiary or other business entity, and are all subsidiaries 100% owned and in good standing?
remediation_action: Compile an active organizational chart and obtain certificates of good standing for all operating subsidiaries.

question_text: Have all required corporate actions by the Board of Directors and stockholders been duly taken to authorize transaction agreements, equity issuances, and charter amendments?
remediation_action: Execute unanimous written consents of the Board and stockholders ratifying all historical corporate actions.

question_text: Are there any transactions, contracts, outstanding loans, or payment commitments between the company and any officer, director, founder, or 5%+ stockholder (excluding standard employment compensation)?
remediation_action: Formalize or terminate outstanding insider loans and obtain independent Audit Committee / Board approval.

question_text: Does the Certificate of Incorporation contain clear class voting thresholds and protective provisions governing major corporate events (M&A, liquidation, debt issuance)?
remediation_action: Amend Certificate of Incorporation to align protective provisions with NVCA standard language.

question_text: Does the company maintain a formalized Code of Ethics, Anti-Corruption/FCPA policy, and Whistleblower mechanism for reporting compliance violations?
remediation_action: Adopt a board-approved Code of Conduct and establish an anonymous whistleblower reporting channel.

question_text: Are complete and signed minutes of all meetings of the Board of Directors and stockholders maintained in the company minute book from inception to the present?
remediation_action: Review corporate records with outside counsel and draft omnibus board ratifications for undocumented past actions.

question_text: Have the company's historical financial statements been prepared in accordance with US GAAP applied on a consistent basis throughout the periods indicated?
remediation_action: Engage an external CPA firm to convert cash-basis financials to accrual GAAP and formalize revenue recognition policies.

question_text: Does the company have any material debts, liabilities, or off-balance-sheet commitments that are not reflected or reserved against on the historical balance sheet?
remediation_action: Review all unrecorded liabilities, lease commitments, and guarantees with the accounting team and update balance sheet.

question_text: Has the company timely filed all federal, state, local, and foreign tax returns and paid all taxes due, including payroll, sales/use, and franchise taxes?
remediation_action: Conduct a sales tax nexus study, file outstanding state and federal returns, and remit any outstanding penalties.

question_text: Are all stock option grants backed by an independent Section 409A fair market valuation report issued within the preceding 12 months (or upon any material financing event)?
remediation_action: Order an expedited independent 409A valuation to establish a clean safe-harbor strike price for option grants.

question_text: Have nationwide UCC, judgment, and federal/state tax lien searches been completed, and are all company assets free and clear of unpermitted security interests or liens?
remediation_action: Obtain UCC termination statements (UCC-3) for satisfied historical loans or equipment leases.

question_text: Does the company maintain documented internal accounting controls and policies, including proper segregation of duties between payment authorization and bank reconciliation?
remediation_action: Establish formal dual-authorization payment thresholds and segregate billing from cash receipt recording.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf

question_text: Have independent auditors issued any management recommendation letters or identified any material weaknesses or significant deficiencies in internal controls over the past 3 years?
remediation_action: Implement remediation plans to address all auditor-flagged control deficiencies before institutional audit closing.

question_text: Are all credit agreements, bank debt facilities, letters of credit, and promissory notes in full compliance with all affirmative and negative financial covenants?
remediation_action: Obtain formal waiver letters from senior lenders for any technical covenant breaches.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Van Doorne Template Due Diligence Request List.V3.pdf

question_text: Are there any pending, threatened, or ongoing claims, lawsuits, administrative proceedings, arbitrations, or governmental inquiries against the company, founders, or officers?
remediation_action: Disclose full litigation docket to legal counsel, obtain audit response letters from outside counsel, and create reserve if necessary.

question_text: Does the company own or possess valid, unencumbered rights to all patents, trademarks, service marks, copyrights, trade secrets, and software code necessary to conduct its business?
remediation_action: Conduct an internal IP audit, record assignments at the USPTO, and verify clean chain of title for all registered assets.

question_text: Has every current and former founder, employee, and independent contractor who contributed to company technology or IP executed a binding Proprietary Information and Inventions Agreement (PIIA)?
remediation_action: Audit employee and contractor files, locate missing PIIA agreements, and execute retroactive confirmatory IP assignments.

question_text: Does the company's proprietary software code include or link with any open-source software under copyleft licenses (e.g., GPL, AGPL) that could require public disclosure of proprietary source code?
remediation_action: Run automated Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scan and refactor or replace all viral copyleft components.

question_text: Are all material agreements (customer contracts > $100k, debt instruments, exclusivity clauses, MFN provisions) fully executed, in good standing, and free of material breach or notice of termination?
remediation_action: Compile a material contract matrix detailing term, termination rights, liability caps, and notice requirements.

question_text: Does the company hold all governmental licenses, permits, franchises, and authorizations required to operate its facilities and conduct its current commercial activities?
remediation_action: Apply for and secure all municipal, state, and federal operational permits prior to diligence signoff.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf

question_text: Has the company, its affiliates, or any representative violated the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), UK Bribery Act, or OFAC economic sanctions regulations?
remediation_action: Adopt formal FCPA anti-bribery policies and run sanctions screening on all foreign partners and intermediaries.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Van Doorne Template Due Diligence Request List.V3.pdf

question_text: Are all primary brand names, logos, registered trademarks, and primary Internet domain names owned directly by the corporate entity and free of adverse claims or disputes?
remediation_action: Transfer domain ownership from founder personal accounts to the corporate entity and record trademark assignments.

question_text: Does the company maintain active insurance policies (including Commercial General Liability, Directors & Officers (D&O), Errors & Omissions (E&O), and Cyber Liability) with adequate coverage limits?
remediation_action: Engage a commercial insurance broker to bind appropriate D&O and cyber liability policies prior to financing close.

question_text: Does the company own or lease all tangible personal property and equipment necessary to conduct business, free of default under any material capital lease agreement?
remediation_action: Compile an asset ledger and confirm lease payoff status or buy-out options with lessor financing partners.
source_ref: Section 2.21 (Title to Assets and Condition of Property)

question_text: Has the company suffered any material data breaches, unauthorized system intrusions, or ransomware incidents, and does it maintain written data privacy and incident response policies?
remediation_action: Adopt a formal Written Information Security Policy (WISP) and implement mandatory incident response protocols.

question_text: Has the company conducted an operational Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plan (BCP) simulation or tabletop exercise within the past 12 months?
remediation_action: Conduct a documented failover simulation of primary infrastructure and record RTO/RPO metrics.

question_text: Has an independent third-party penetration test and vulnerability assessment of external and internal infrastructure been conducted within the past 12 months?
remediation_action: Commission an external CREST-certified penetration testing firm to audit cloud attack surfaces and remediate high-severity CVEs.

question_text: Is primary software application hosting architected with automated multi-zone or multi-region failover and daily off-site encrypted data backups?
remediation_action: Enable automated cross-region database snapshot replication and test backup restoration integrity.

question_text: Does the company maintain a formal third-party vendor risk assessment program that audits cloud, hosting, and SaaS vendors for security compliance and SOC 2 reports?
remediation_action: Inventory all third-party software subprocessors and request updated SOC 2 reports or ISO certificates.

question_text: Are all commercial office, lab, or warehouse lease agreements fully executed, current in rent obligations, and free of landlord default notices or pending eviction proceedings?
remediation_action: Request tenant estoppel certificates from commercial landlords verifying no default under active premises leases.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf

question_text: Are all workers correctly classified as exempt/non-exempt under the FLSA and properly categorized as W-2 employees versus 1099 independent contractors?
remediation_action: Conduct an independent wage-and-hour audit and reclassify any contractors who function as full-time employees.

question_text: Does the company maintain a comprehensive employee census listing every employee's name, title, department, salary, bonus structure, hire date, and immigration/visa status?
remediation_action: Standardize the HR census and audit Form I-9 files and H-1B/TN visa petitions for foreign national staff.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf

question_text: Are all C-level executives and key personnel bound by executed employment offer letters that define at-will employment, compensation, and severance triggers?
remediation_action: Execute standard executive employment agreements containing formal at-will language and clear IP assignment clauses.

question_text: Are all employee health, retirement, 401(k), and equity incentive benefit plans operated in compliance with ERISA, the Internal Revenue Code, and ACA requirements?
remediation_action: Review annual Form 5500 filings and perform 401(k) discrimination testing with plan administrators.

question_text: Are there any pending or threatened claims, arbitrations, or EEOC charges alleging sexual harassment, discrimination, wrongful termination, or wage disputes?
remediation_action: Disclose any historical settlement agreements containing non-disclosure terms to outside legal counsel for risk assessment.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf

question_text: What is the annual voluntary and involuntary employee turnover rate over the trailing 12 months, specifically among engineering and sales personnel?
remediation_action: Analyze exit interview feedback and adjust equity vesting / retention packages for key technical contributors.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist by Funding Stage - Ser.pdf

question_text: Do any executive or employee contracts trigger single-trigger or double-trigger accelerated equity vesting or cash severance upon a financing or change of control?
remediation_action: Model change-of-control payout liabilities and renegotiate single-trigger acceleration terms to standard double-trigger.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf
source_ref: Section 6.1 (Severance and Change of Control Liabilities)

question_text: Are proprietary restrictive covenants (non-compete, non-solicitation, and non-disclosure) updated to comply with current state and federal labor regulations?
remediation_action: Review restrictive covenants with counsel to ensure compliance with California/FTC non-compete rules while safeguarding trade secrets.

question_text: Are there any side letters or special agreements that grant any shareholder preferential liquidity, redemption rights, or information rights superior to the standard IRA?
remediation_action: Review and harmonize all side letter commitments into the primary investor agreements with legal counsel.

question_text: Do any active debt facilities, leases, customer contracts, or commercial licenses require third-party counterparty consent or notification in connection with a change of control or equity financing?
remediation_action: Draft consent request letters and initiate outreach to key counterparties requiring closing consent.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf

question_text: Have all holders of contractual or statutory preemptive rights, rights of first refusal, or rights of first offer executed formal written waivers for the proposed financing round?
remediation_action: Obtain signed preemptive right waivers from major investors possessing pro rata participation rights.
source_ref: Section 4.1 (Right of First Offer and Waivers)

question_text: Are all historical Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFEs), convertible notes, and bridge loans fully reconciled and converted or accounted for in the pro forma cap table?
remediation_action: Build a comprehensive SAFE conversion spreadsheet verifying valuation caps, discounts, and pre/post-money terms with counsel.

question_text: Is a complete virtual data room (VDR) organized with consistent index folders and redacting sensitive PII or unredacted customer terms prior to investor opening?
remediation_action: Organize data room folders matching institutional diligence checklists and apply PII redaction to sample contracts.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist by Funding Stage - Ser.pdf

question_text: Are there any broker, finder, investment banking, or financial advisory fee arrangements that will become payable upon the closing of this transaction?
remediation_action: Review broker engagement letters and verify fee percentages and tail provisions with the Board.

question_text: Do any existing shareholders possess demand, piggyback, or Form S-3 registration rights that could impede or restrict future public market liquidity or IPO filing?
remediation_action: Harmonize historical registration rights agreements into an amended and restated IRA.

question_text: Does the company's charter, bylaws, or any contract contain shareholder rights plans ('poison pills') or super-majority voting provisions that complicate strategic acquisitions?
remediation_action: Review supermajority provisions with corporate counsel and streamline voting mechanics for institutional sell-side exit.

question_text: What is the variance percentage between the board-approved annual revenue budget and the actual recognized revenue over the trailing 12 months?
remediation_action: Implement a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast and transition from annual budgeting to quarterly re-forecasting.

question_text: What is the total dollar amount of non-recurring management 'add-backs' to EBITDA (e.g., personal expenses, one-time legal fees, owner salaries)?
remediation_action: Engage a third-party CPA to conduct an independent Quality of Earnings (QoE) audit to normalize EBITDA before opening the data room.

question_text: What is the Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), and average CAC payback period in months?
remediation_action: Audit sales and marketing efficiency by channel and eliminate underperforming acquisition channels exceeding 18-month payback.

question_text: What was the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) and organic year-over-year revenue growth rate across the past 3 historical fiscal years?
remediation_action: Separate organic product revenue growth from acquisition-driven or one-time professional services revenue.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist by Funding Stage - Ser.pdf

question_text: Does the company capitalize internal software development or R&D costs under ASC 350-40, and what percentage of total engineering expense is capitalized?
remediation_action: Document software capitalization policies with CPA to ensure alignment with standard institutional tech diligence guidelines.

question_text: Is the forward 3-to-5 year financial model fully driver-based (integrating headcount additions, marketing CAC, and cohort retention) rather than simple percentage extrapolations?
remediation_action: Rebuild pro forma financial projections with bottom-up headcount schedules and documented capacity metrics.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/GCV Investor Due Diligence Checklist.pdf

question_text: Does the company produce a monthly bridge reconciling GAAP Recognized Revenue, Invoiced Bookings, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), and Deferred Revenue balances?
remediation_action: Implement an automated ARR waterfall report tracking new logos, expansion, contraction, and churn monthly.

question_text: What is the forward 12-month sales pipeline coverage ratio (weighted qualified pipeline divided by remaining annual net-new revenue target)?
remediation_action: Clean stale CRM opportunities older than 90 days and enforce stage-gated probability qualification.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist by Funding Stage - Ser.pdf

question_text: What is the average monthly net cash burn over the last 6 months, and exactly how many months of cash runway remain under current balances?
remediation_action: Execute an immediate hiring freeze and freeze all non-essential CapEx to extend runway past the 9-month threshold.

question_text: What is the company's gross margin percentage, fully burdened by customer success, hosting, and implementation costs?
remediation_action: Conduct a pricing audit to pass inflationary costs to customers and renegotiate vendor/hosting contracts to expand gross margins.

question_text: Does the company produce monthly cash flow statements demonstrating positive Free Cash Flow or a clear trend of operating cash burn reduction over the past 4 quarters?
remediation_action: Implement monthly operating cash flow tracking and analyze working capital changes driving cash deficits.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Due Diligence Checklist for M&A.pdf
source_ref: Section 2.4 (Cash Flow and Working Capital Analysis)

question_text: What is the normalized Net Working Capital (NWC) dollar requirement, and are there material seasonal swings in inventory or receivable collections?
remediation_action: Establish a 12-month trailing NWC peg calculation and implement tighter inventory turnover targets.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Van Doorne Template Due Diligence Request List.V3.pdf
source_ref: Section 2.2 (Net Working Capital and Seasonal Variations)

question_text: Does trailing EBITDA or operating cash flow provide at least a 1.25x Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) relative to annual principal and interest obligations?
remediation_action: Refinance short-term maturities or negotiate interest-only amortization holiday with senior lenders.

question_text: What percentage of outstanding accounts payable is past due beyond standard vendor terms (over 60 days past invoice due date)?
remediation_action: Establish payment plans for past-due vendors to cure trade debt defaults before data room verification.

question_text: What is the historical and projected annual Maintenance Capital Expenditure (CapEx) required to keep operating equipment and technology platforms functional?
remediation_action: Segregate growth CapEx from ongoing maintenance CapEx in audited historical schedules.

question_text: Does the company have any outstanding earnout liabilities, deferred acquisition payments, or royalty commitments stemming from prior asset purchases?
remediation_action: Audit contingent earnout milestones and obtain settlement or escrow payoff agreements.
source_doc: data/ASP/law firms reports/Van Doorne Template Due Diligence Request List.V3.pdf
source_ref: Section 2.5 (Contingent Liabilities and Historical Acquisition Terms)

question_text: What percentage of total gross revenue is generated by the Top 1, Top 3, and Top 5 largest customers?
remediation_action: Restructure sales incentives to prioritize net-new logos in adjacent market segments to dilute Top 5 customer concentration.

question_text: What percentage of total revenue is contractually recurring (e.g., multi-year subscriptions) versus one-off, project-based transactional revenue?
remediation_action: Transition existing transactional/per-project clients to annual retainer contracts with automatic renewal clauses.

question_text: What is the Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Dollar Retention (GDR) across historical customer cohorts over the last 24 months?
remediation_action: Implement a dedicated Customer Success up-sell matrix and enforce 90-day preemptive check-ins prior to contract renewal dates.

question_text: What percentage of enterprise customer contracts have a committed term of 12 months or greater and feature automatic annual renewal mechanisms?
remediation_action: Adopt multi-year standard order form templates with opt-out renewal windows capped at 30 days.

question_text: Does the company maintain an ASC 606 revenue recognition schedule tying upfront annual billings directly to deferred revenue liabilities on the balance sheet?
remediation_action: Implement subscription billing software that synchronizes unearned revenue schedules with accounting software.
source_ref: Section 5.3 (Revenue Recognition Policies and Deferred Revenue)

question_text: What is the annual customer logo churn percentage (percentage of unique logos terminating active contracts over the trailing 12 months)?
remediation_action: Conduct churn post-mortems and establish onboarding health score triggers to intervene before renewal cycles.

question_text: Do standard multi-year customer agreements include annual price escalation clauses (e.g., 3-5% or CPI indexation) upon contract anniversary or renewal?

source_ref: Section 4.1 (Commercial Contract Terms and Price Indexation)
